successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: the island of Ngazidja (Grande Comore), 1,025 km2, divided among Bambao, Itsandra, Mitsamihuli, Mbadjini, Hambuu, Washili, Hamahame, Mbwankuu, Mbude and Domba

ledger.x: c. 1500: Grande Comore is divided among many sultanates (mfaume); the start year is the task's estimate, the page gives no founding date.
1886: Sultan Said Ali declares a state of Ngazidja and accepts a French protectorate over the island.
1886: the independent sultanates end in the French protectorate.

certainty.note: No borders between sultanates; whole island used.
